description: On the counter in front of you are a yellow squeeze bottle, three small cups (yellow, red, green), a blue cup, and a blue sponge. The left hand and right hand hold the blue cup together while the left hand pulls the blue sponge out from inside it, then sets the sponge down; the right hand moves the blue cup to the far right, and both hands reach back toward the other cups and the yellow bottle as if preparing to continue cleaning.
